correctness.rationale: The theorem fixes the rotating-frame Lindbladian and \(\gamma/4\) jump normalization with \(F,g,\gamma>0\), arbitrary \(\rho_0\) and trace normalization. \(Q^2=I\) follows from anticommuting Pauli products; \([H,Q]=[Z_{\mathrm C},Q]=0\) follows from explicit commutators. The exact real Hilbert–Schmidt dissipation identity forces fixed operators to commute with \(Z_{\mathrm C}\). Since the off-diagonal block \(T=FI+g\sigma^-\) is invertible and \(TT^\dagger\) has distinct eigenvalues \(F^2+g^2/2\pm gs/2\), where \(s=\sqrt{g^2+4F^2}\), fixed operators form precisely \(\operatorname{span}\{I,Q\}\). An imaginary-axis eigenoperator must both be charger-Z diagonal and a nonzero-frequency Hamiltonian eigenoperator, impossible by block parity. The bounded finite-dimensional unital CP semigroup has no nontrivial peripheral Jordan chains; all other eigenvalues decay. The limit is the trace-orthogonal projection \(A\mapsto[\operatorname{Tr}(A)I+\operatorname{Tr}(QA)Q]/4\) and equals a rank-two binary measure–prepare channel. Conditional battery states have noncommuting Bloch vectors precisely when \(Fgc^2\ne0\), proving the one-sided discord condition; partial traces give ergotropy and energy. 80 actual finite numerical checks of full \(16\times16\) Liouvillian corroborate algebra and the known ground-state limit but do not replace universal proof.

originality.rationale: Shastri et al., arXiv:2402.16999v1, supply the model, its closed moment equations, and the ground-state limiting energy and ergotropy, which are expressly not claimed. Purkait et al., arXiv:2508.13497, explicitly note nonunique resonant stationary states, also not claimed. Their inspected full texts do not give the exact every-input stationary channel, its two-dimensional fixed algebra, the entanglement-breaking conclusion against external references, the strict battery-side discord criterion, or the sharp arbitrary-initial-state ergotropy envelope. The related Farina thermal-damping model and Wang-Jin non-Markovian early-time model are not stronger equivalent claims. General finite-dimensional unital fixed-point theory supplies a proof method but not the model-specific invariant and structure. The accessible recorded research results on other dephasing/entanglement and the prior local-reset Ising model do not imply this specialization. Residual supplemental/unindexed coverage risk remains.

value.rationale: The exact fixed-point algebra and quantum-channel limit resolve a natural, previously unspecified all-initial-state question for an experimentally motivated dephased quantum battery. The binary-measurement representation demonstrates a genuinely operational sharp information-loss boundary: the long-time joint system has no entanglement with any reference, even though the battery can retain directional discord and preparation-dependent extractable work. The precise bound over all inputs, its extremizers, and the distinction from the published ground-state \(0.25\omega_{\mathrm B}\) optimum establish a meaningful complete natural classification. None of this asserts energy gain from cost-free preparation or depends on an arbitrary parameter slice. Existing generic unital semigroup lemmas are explicitly methods, not scientific results claimed as original.
